explanations.title: Measure review quality and performance
explanations.summary: Adds a reusable evaluation runner that reviews every validated dataset case and reports aggregate precision, recall, total cost, and median latency. A reviewer error stops the run and identifies the failing case.

explanations.title: Check for quality regressions
explanations.summary: Adds a quality regression check that returns an error when precision or recall falls by more than the configured threshold (3 percentage points by default). Cost and latency are measured by the runner but do not affect this check.
